name: Multilevel Personality Questionnaire "Adaptability" (MLO-AM)
description: The Multilevel Personality Questionnaire "Adaptability" (MLO-AM) was developed by A. G. Maklakov and S. V. Chermyanin. It assesses a person's capacity to adapt, taking into account social, psychological and some psychophysiological characteristics that reflect general features of neuropsychological and social development.
instruction: You will be asked a series of questions to answer only "yes" or "no". The questions are about how you feel, how you behave and what your character is like. There are no "right" or "wrong" answers, so don't think too long or consult anyone: answer according to what best matches your state or your view of yourself.

summaries.Группа низкой адаптации. Лица этой групп: Low adaptation group. People in this group show clear character accentuations and some signs of psychopathy; their mental state can be described as borderline. Breakdowns are possible. They have low neuropsychological stability, are prone to conflict and may act antisocially. They need to be monitored by a psychologist and a doctor (neurologist, psychiatrist).
summaries.Группа удовлетворительной адаптации. Бол: Satisfactory adaptation group. Most people in this group show signs of various accentuations that are partly compensated in familiar conditions and may surface when their activity changes, so their success in adapting depends on external conditions. As a rule they have fairly low emotional stability. Antisocial breakdowns, aggression and conflict are possible. They need an individual approach, ongoing monitoring and support.
summaries.Группы высокой и нормальной адаптации. Л: High and normal adaptation groups. People in these groups adapt quite easily to new conditions, quickly fit into a new team, get their bearings in a situation easily and appropriately, and quickly work out how to act. As a rule they are not prone to conflict and have high emotional stability.
summaries.Низкий уровень поведенческой регуляции,: Low behavioural self-regulation, some tendency towards breakdowns, inaccurate self-esteem and an unrealistic perception of reality.
summaries.Высокий уровень нервно-психической устой: High neuropsychological stability and behavioural self-regulation, high and accurate self-esteem and a realistic perception of reality.
summaries.Низкий уровень развития коммуникативных: Poorly developed communication skills, difficulty building relationships with others, aggressiveness and a heightened tendency towards conflict.
summaries.Высокий уровень развития коммуникативных: Well-developed communication skills; easily builds relationships with colleagues and others, not prone to conflict.
summaries.Не может адекватно оценить свое место и: Cannot accurately assess their place and role in the team and does not try to follow generally accepted norms of behaviour.
summaries.Показатели по шкале моральной нормативно: Moral normativity within the normal range
summaries.Реально оценивает свою роль в коллективе: Realistically assesses their role in the team and follows generally accepted norms of behaviour.
